- The inset rounded main sheet is gone. The main column is now the page itself at full height. The sidebar is a tinted rail (232px), separated from the page by one hairline (--side-edge). The --panel-ring token is removed from every theme.
- The sidebar is denser: 13px medium labels on 28px rows, 1px between rows and 20px between groups. Section headings are 12px muted. The head buttons are 24px and the head stays level with the page's top bar.
- Colour: the Space tile uses the theme's accent (--you). The current view is a pill tinted with --you, and its glyph is lit in --you (--you-text in dark themes; new token --side-on-glyph). So the frame shows which theme is on.
- View counts are now plain muted numbers instead of white boxed badges. This removes the --side-count-fill, --side-count-ring, --side-count, --side-count-on and --side-count-h tokens.
- The theme row matches the compact rows (13px label, 12px current theme name). The theme menu swatches are larger (38x24) and redrawn as the new frame in miniature: the rail with its accent tile, a hairline, then the page with a line of ink and a line of your move.
- Theme tokens are reworked for the rail: Paper 4% ink, dark themes 22% black under the page, accent-tinted active pills. Token comments now say rail and page instead of sheet, and the Frame ledger reasons are updated (flush main column, muted numeral counts).
- Kit size went down: 8339 lines in all, under the starting size. No components, props, budget or raises were changed.

verdicts.summary:
Explore direction "status-washed sheet". Each group's band is now tinted with its state's colour, so where each run of tickets starts is shown by colour rather than lines.
- Group heads (Head): the band takes a light wash of the group's state colour: indigo for Needs you / Your move, orange for Running / Agents at work, red for Blocked, green for Done. Neutral groups use a lighter ink wash. The count is written in the same colour, the name is weight 600, and the hairline under the band is gone. Two new tones (live, blocked) were added to Head and to Badge's count. CompactView maps each group to its tone, and QueueView sets Agents at work to live. The bands are built from new tokens (--band-tint per theme, plus --band-ink/you/live/blocked/done mixed from the base colours).
- Rows (Row line): density goes from 44px to 40px (--h-line), with no separators between rows; the group bands do that job. Hover, focus and the open row now show a rounded slab inset 6px from the edges. In Compact the open row's expansion sits inside the slab, washed in your accent. Item rows (Intake) keep their hairline.
- Chips: flat tags with a faint ink fill, no outline, 6px radius, 20px tall (was 22). The tokens header already said "borders are for controls", and this now matches it. The fill tone is one step firmer.
- Agents at work tiles (Card agent look): running tiles are flat grey slabs with no border or shadow. Queued tiles are an empty dashed outline, matching the dashed queued glyph. The Meter's bottom-edge hairline (size edge) is replaced by size tile: a still, 76px segmented meter set inline before the step count.
- Cleanup: removed the tokens nothing uses any more (--list-label-edge, --tile-meter-track, --tile-quiet-edge, --tile-bar). Updated the ledger entries and source comments for Head, Badge, Chip, Meter, Row and Card so they stay true.
Kit: 8,363 lines before, 8,380 after (+17 net), 44/45 components; "budget" and "raises" untouched.
Environment note: in this worktree the node_modules junction made Vite return 403 for the Geist font files, so pages rendered in a fallback font. To shoot with the real font, I made web\node_modules a real folder holding junctions to each package plus a real copy of @fontsource. This changed only the worktree, not C:\code\AgentOS-V2-web, and isn't part of the patch. The final shots are in Geist.

verdicts.summary:
The challenger rebuilds All teams as Linear's swimlane board.
- **Repo heads.** The left "Team" column is gone. Each repo gets one head line across the full board: name, in-flight count, path, coloured people faces, and "Open list →" at the far right. The four stage lanes now use the whole width.
- **Wells.** Each stage lane in a swimlane is a rounded well set a step into the sheet: a grey well with an inner hairline in light, a black-mixed well in dark. The white or lit cards stand out of it. An empty lane stays a bare well, so the board's shape shows. A repo with nothing in flight gets one quiet full-width well.
- **Spacing.** Swimlanes are separated by space instead of hairline rules. Column heads are inset to line up with the card keys.
- **Cards.** Cards drop from three lines to two, like Linear's board card: the key and the state chip on one line (chip at the far end), then the status glyph and the title in 13px medium.
- **Kit changes.** Row gets a `head` prop (rendered for bands), and the band CSS is rewritten. The ticket Card's main area stretches so its line reaches the card's far edge. Two new tokens (`--lane-well`, `--lane-well-edge`) are mixed from the base tokens in the light and dark blocks; the unused `--h-band` is removed. The ledger entries for Row (band, head) and Card ticket are updated.
- **Budget.** The kit grows by 17 lines net (8363 to 8380). Components stay at 44/45; budget and raises are unchanged.

To make the shots, I temporarily added `server.fs.allow` to `web/vite.config.ts`. Without it, Vite refuses to serve the Geist fonts through the junctioned `node_modules` and the shots fall back to a system font. That change is reverted and is not in the patch. Other builders' shots from junctioned worktrees will likely show the wrong font for the same reason.

Note: the camera writes into a `teams` subfolder of the given output folder.

- A new pinned bar (Dialog's new `bar` prop, side look only) holds the type glyph and key on the left, then a quiet Open ticket, the ticket menu and a quiet close. Its hairline sits on the same line where the page's own top bar ends (h-top + sp-4), so the two read as one bar across the window.
- The title is now 24px display, matching the ticket page. Text's unused "title" variant is removed, which saves kit lines.
- The panel's Sections are set apart by space instead of hairlines, so the peek reads as one document (like Linear's doc page) between its pinned bar and its pinned composer.

Full-window editors (workflow overlay and item overlay):
- The editor is the app's main sheet lifted over the window: inset sp-4 and corner r-4, the same as the frame's sheet, with a deeper --shadow-float on the scrim.
- The bar is a window chrome: the close, then a short vertical rule, then the Page's top bar. One hairline runs edge to edge under all of it, so it no longer stops at the close's column.
